name: Ticket to Heart
source: Ticket to Heart is a short visual novel revolving around Emmy, a young woman trying to reconnect with a long-lost friend. The ride to Mistlefir is long and filled with many surprises along the way!
translation: 《心灵的门票》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了年轻女子艾美试图与失散已久的朋友重新取得联系的故事。前往Mistlefir的旅程漫长且充满惊喜！
